OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the observable types to import.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

TAXII2_USERNAME.description: The username used for basic authentication against the TAXII server.

TAXII2_PASSWORD.description: The password used for basic authentication against the TAXII server.

TAXII2_USE_TOKEN.description: Whether to use bearer token authentication instead of basic authentication.

TAXII2_TOKEN.description: The bearer token used to authenticate against the TAXII server.

TAXII2_USE_APIKEY.description: Whether to use API key authentication instead of basic authentication.

TAXII2_APIKEY_KEY.description: The name of the HTTP header holding the API key.

TAXII2_APIKEY_VALUE.description: The value of the API key sent in the API key HTTP header.

TAXII2_USE_CERT.description: Whether to use a client certificate (mTLS) to connect to the TAXII server.

TAXII2_CERT_PATH.description: The path to the client certificate used for mTLS.

TAXII2_VERIFY_SSL.description: Whether to verify the SSL certificate of the TAXII server.

TAXII2_V21.description: Whether the TAXII server is TAXII 2.1 compliant. Set to `false` for TAXII 2.0.

TAXII2_COLLECTIONS.description: The collections to poll, formatted as `api_root.collection`. Wildcards are supported, e.g. `*.*` to poll every collection of every API root.

TAXII2_INITIAL_HISTORY.description: The number of hours of history to fetch during the first run.

TAXII2_CREATE_INDICATORS.description: Whether to create indicators from the imported observables.

TAXII2_CREATE_OBSERVABLES.description: Whether to create observables from the imported indicators.

TAXII2_ADD_CUSTOM_LABEL.description: Whether to add a custom label to all the imported objects.

TAXII2_CUSTOM_LABEL.description: The custom label to add to all the imported objects.

TAXII2_FORCE_PATTERN_AS_NAME.description: Whether to use the indicator pattern as the indicator name.

TAXII2_FORCE_MULTIPLE_PATTERN_NAME.description: The name to give to indicators holding multiple patterns.

TAXII2_STIX_CUSTOM_PROPERTY_TO_LABEL.description: Whether to convert a custom STIX property into an OpenCTI label.

TAXII2_STIX_CUSTOM_PROPERTY.description: The name of the custom STIX property to convert into a label.

TAXII2_ENABLE_URL_QUERY_LIMIT.description: Whether to add a `limit` query parameter to the TAXII server requests. Only supported by TAXII 2.1 servers.

TAXII2_URL_QUERY_LIMIT.description: The value of the `limit` query parameter sent to the TAXII server.

TAXII2_DETERMINE_X_OPENCTI_SCORE_BY_LABE.description: Whether to determine the OpenCTI score of an indicator from its labels.

TAXII2_DEFAULT_X_OPENCTI_SCORE.description: The OpenCTI score to set when no label matches.

TAXII2_INDICATOR_HIGH_SCORE_LABELS.description: The labels triggering the high OpenCTI score.

TAXII2_INDICATOR_HIGH_SCORE.description: The OpenCTI score to set for indicators matching a high score label.

TAXII2_INDICATOR_MEDIUM_SCORE_LABELS.description: The labels triggering the medium OpenCTI score.

TAXII2_INDICATOR_MEDIUM_SCORE.description: The OpenCTI score to set for indicators matching a medium score label.

TAXII2_INDICATOR_LOW_SCORE_LABELS.description: The labels triggering the low OpenCTI score.

TAXII2_INDICATOR_LOW_SCORE.description: The OpenCTI score to set for indicators matching a low score label.

TAXII2_SET_INDICATOR_AS_DETECTION.description: Whether to flag the imported indicators as detection.

TAXII2_CREATE_AUTHOR.description: Whether to create an author identity and link it to the imported objects.

TAXII2_AUTHOR_NAME.description: The name of the author identity to create.

TAXII2_AUTHOR_DESCRIPTION.description: The description of the author identity to create.

TAXII2_AUTHOR_RELIABILITY.description: The reliability of the author identity to create, e.g. `A - Completely reliable`.

TAXII2_EXCLUDE_SPECIFIC_LABELS.description: Whether to exclude some labels from the imported objects.

TAXII2_LABELS_TO_EXCLUDE.description: The regular expressions matching the labels to exclude.

TAXII2_REPLACE_CHARACTERS_IN_LABEL.description: Whether to replace characters in the imported labels.

TAXII2_CHARACTERS_TO_REPLACE_IN_LABEL.description: The replacement rules to apply to labels, formatted as a comma-separated list of `find:replace` pairs.

TAXII2_IGNORE_PATTERN_TYPES.description: Whether to ignore indicators based on their pattern type.

TAXII2_PATTERN_TYPES_TO_IGNORE.description: The indicator pattern types to ignore, e.g. `stix, yara`.

TAXII2_IGNORE_OBJECT_TYPES.description: Whether to ignore STIX objects based on their type.

TAXII2_OBJECT_TYPES_TO_IGNORE.description: The STIX object types to ignore, e.g. `report, note`.

TAXII2_IGNORE_SPECIFIC_PATTERNS.description: Whether to ignore indicators based on their pattern content.

TAXII2_PATTERNS_TO_IGNORE.description: The indicator pattern contents to ignore.

TAXII2_IGNORE_SPECIFIC_NOTES.description: Whether to ignore notes based on their content.

TAXII2_SAVE_ORIGINAL_INDICATOR_ID_TO_NOT.description: Whether to save the original indicator ID into an OpenCTI note.

TAXII2_SAVE_ORIGINAL_INDICATOR_ID_ABSTRA.description: The abstract of the note holding the original indicator ID.

TAXII2_CHANGE_REPORT_STATUS.description: Whether to override the workflow status of the imported reports.

TAXII2_CHANGE_REPORT_STATUS_X_OPENCTI_WO.description: The OpenCTI workflow status ID to set on the imported reports.
